name: browser-use
headline: Home Assistant management with Claude Code skill
short_description: Claude Code skill for expert-level Home Assistant configuration management. Enables efficient deployment workflows, remote CLI access, automation verification, and Lovelace dashboard development. Ideal for operations teams managing smart home systems.
author: komal-SkyNET

sections.overview:
This skill transforms Claude into a Home Assistant expert capable of managing configurations, automations, and Lovelace dashboards at an expert level. It handles rapid development workflows using scp for testing and git for version control, automatically determines when to reload versus restart, and validates configurations before deployment. The skill includes complete automation verification protocols that test automations by triggering them manually and analyzing logs for errors. For dashboard development, it provides tablet-optimized Lovelace design expertise including card type selection, Jinja2 template patterns, and responsive layouts for different screen sizes. Operations teams managing smart home systems benefit from streamlined deployment decisions and iterative debugging workflows.
Create and test Home Assistant automations with instant deployment and log verification
Build touch-friendly Lovelace dashboards optimized for tablet screens (7", 11", 13")
Debug template errors and type mismatches in automations using log analysis
Manage remote Home Assistant instances via SSH with hass-cli commands
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/komal-SkyNET/claude-skill-homeassistant`
sections.usage:
```
Act as a Home Assistant automation expert using Claude Code. Use the [HOME_ASSISTANT_CONFIG_PATH] directory to perform the following tasks: 1) Validate the YAML configuration files for syntax errors and best practices, 2) Generate a report of all active automations with their last trigger time and status, 3) Create a backup of the current configuration with timestamp, 4) Suggest 3 optimizations for the [SPECIFIC_AUTOMATION_NAME] automation based on energy efficiency and reliability metrics. Execute these tasks in sequence and provide a summary of findings.
```
